messages:
marta: Heads-up — master CI is red after the GCC image roll. Failing link on //runtime:gpu_worker. Can't repro locally yet. Anyone able to bisect or take a look? cc @eng-infra
ci-bot: Buildkite job #3421 failed: step 'linux-gcc-11' — https://buildkite.company/organizations/redwood/pipelines/main/builds/3421 :x:
eric: :eyes: seeing the same on my branch. Link error excerpt: ```/usr/bin/ld: bazel-out/k8-fastbuild/bin/runtime/_objs/gpu_worker/worker.o: undefined reference to `__atomic_load_8' /usr/bin/ld: final link failed: 1 unresolved external```
anita: Probably a libc++/glibc mismatch from the image bump. Which image tag did infra roll?
infra-bot: Toolchain image rolled: gcr.io/redwood/toolchain:2026-03-15-gcc11. Note: default CXX ABI policy changed to libstdc++ for that image.
jon: I'll take this and bisect. Starting range: f6e5d4c..a1b2c3d. Plan: `git bisect start a1b2c3d f6e5d4c` then `git bisect run ./ci_scripts/replicate_bazel.sh //runtime:gpu_worker`
marta: Thanks — pls ping here if you find the culprit. If bisect points to the image we can rollback quickly. :pray:
jon: Quick repro tip for local folks: `bazel build //runtime:gpu_worker --config=linux-gcc11 --cxxopt='-D_GLIBCXX_USE_CXX11_ABI=0'`. Without forcing the ABI I hit the same link error. Starting bisect now.
eric: FWIW, as a temporary workaround I added `linkopts = ["-latomic"]` on the target in my branch which gets past the link, but that's a bandaid.
ci-bot: Rerun triggered by @jon — queued buildkite job #3422.
anita: :thumbsup: if bisect shows the image is the culprit, let's add a guarded release-note + revert plan. Also consider a CI matrix entry to catch both cxxabi variants.
jon: Bisect update — step 6/12: found first bad commit 9c8d7b2. It looks like the docker base image was bumped and glibc/libatomic variants changed. Opening a patch to pin the base for the toolchain image. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/456
marta: Nice find, thanks. Please add a CI test for linking against both ABI modes so we don't regress silently.
jon: Will add matrix entry in the infra PR and follow up with a short postmortem. Marking this thread as tracked; will close once PR merges. /cc @eng-oncall
